title: Story 1.4 M0: prerequisite gate sweep in the fresh story worktree
summary: Run the complete prerequisite gate set green before any real-user mutation, per Story 1.4 AC-1: bash tests/lifecycle-tests.sh, bash tests/lifecycle-readiness-tests.sh, bash tests/lifecycle-dispatch-tests.sh, bash tests/run-tests.sh, the mutation suite, and git diff --check, all from the fresh Orca story worktree at master 8a7cbc1. Retain full logs as evidence, report per-gate pass/fail counts and wall time. No product-code changes; writes are limited to evidence files and the Dev Agent Record status line. Any red gate is reported verbatim and classified, never patched by this worker. Context requirement: the worker retains two long-running suite logs (~36 and ~28 minutes of output), the frozen story file, and evidence assembly in one session; declared context_size 150000.
